name: Agent swarm assembly
what: A page assembled live by named cursor agents that place, drag, type and count each layer, with a human foreman who opens and signs the build.

name: HUD build log
what: A control strip that counts agents and layers against the real registry total, streams a timestamped log of which seat placed which layer, and reports the measured build time.

name: Scroll-film dossier
what: Pinned sections that play like film shots with a frame counter, a push-in on the exhibit, and a hand-off to the next section.

name: Data-strip hero
what: A hero whose statistics each carry their source and date in the same cell, counting up on entry.

name: The System seat map
what: An agent fleet shown as software seats with numbers, names, jobs and configuration status, with one human foreman seat.

name: Papers running live
what: Published research methods presented as runnable in-browser instruments beside their citations.
